name: Reitou Kizakura ~Ouka no Ken to Madoiryuu Shou~
original_name: 霊刀キザクラ ～桜花の剣と惑竜章～
source:
Main characters is a knight. He meets a mysterious woman in a remote town on the border of the country. Together they set out on a dangerous journey to slay a dragon.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名騎士。他在該國邊境的一個偏遠小鎮遇到了一位神秘女子。他們一起踏上了危險的屠龍之旅。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]］
